measurement.timing: perf_counter; update call only includes primitive processing and guard lookup; fresh manager per repetition; import/construction/predict/deepcopy/queue-fill/coverage/serialization excluded and separately recorded when relevant
measurement.timing_order: 11 rounds of seeded shuffled job order; a prior unreported-as-data warmup of each variant on base case
measurement.instrumentation: separate runs; instrument all queue instances incl inner primitive queues; total puts/gets, maximum per-queue size and aggregate live item count; primitive call counts; guard dominance checks; terminal representation count
measurement.memory: separate tracemalloc runs; peak additional Python-traced allocations during update; input built before tracing; not native allocator/RSS/full planner memory
measurement.deadline: no realtime threshold asserted; 30 s administrative timeout per bounded repetition; timeout is unresolved runtime/resource result, not safety failure
measurement.coverage: position projection and native zero-horizon position-speed tested separately; immutable finite reference; implicit-tail or unsupported decoder is unresolved, not method failure; native velocity-envelope discrepancy remains separate
measurement.correctness: exact semantic output digest parity between timed/instrumented/memory runs checked; duplicates retained in digest; no outcome-based exclusion
measurement.sufficiency_criterion: finite target t=4 state coverage and termination on tested inputs; cost reported descriptively with no invented practical deadline; full temporal/continuous/planner soundness not claimed
